sources.title: Self Assessment late filing and payment penalties overview
sources.excerpt: If you miss Self Assessment filing or payment deadlines you may have to pay penalties and interest. Penalty amounts and timing depend on how late you are and HMRC rules for the period. Check GOV.UK Self Assessment penalties guidance for current details rather than relying on memory.

sources.title: Records you should keep if self-employed
sources.excerpt: If you are self-employed you must keep records of business income and expenses. Keep records for at least 5 years after the 31 January submission deadline of the relevant tax year. Digital record-keeping becomes especially important under Making Tax Digital.

sources.title: Cryptoassets and tax overview
sources.excerpt: HMRC treats cryptoassets as potentially taxable. Depending on your activity you may need to consider Capital Gains Tax and/or Income Tax. Keep detailed records of transactions. Check GOV.UK cryptoassets tax guidance for how your situation may be treated.
